title: Wayfare Rentals Weekly Rate and Trip Rebate Card
content:
Wayfare Rentals (driver vehicle rentals) are priced by the rental week. Each of the six vehicle classes has its own weekly rate and its own trip rebate steps; the other terms on this card are the same for every class.

## Weekly rate and trip rebate steps by vehicle class

The weekly rate is the rental charge per rental week, in USD. A trip rebate is a credit against the week's rental, set by the number of completed trips in that rental week.

| Vehicle class | Weekly rate | Rebate at 30 completed trips | Rebate at 50 completed trips | Rebate at 70 completed trips |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Wayfare Rentals Economy Sedan | $239.00 | $25.00 | $55.00 | $90.00 |
| Wayfare Rentals Hybrid Sedan | $269.00 | $25.00 | $55.00 | $90.00 |
| Wayfare Rentals Electric Sedan | $289.00 | $30.00 | $65.00 | $105.00 |
| Wayfare Rentals Midsize SUV | $309.00 | $30.00 | $65.00 | $105.00 |
| Wayfare Rentals Minivan | $349.00 | $35.00 | $75.00 | $120.00 |
| Wayfare Rentals Premium Sedan | $419.00 | $40.00 | $85.00 | $140.00 |

Notes to the rebate columns:

1. The highest step reached in the rental week applies, and steps never add: a week that reaches the 50-trip step earns the 50-trip amount alone, not the 30-trip amount as well.
2. Trips that count for the rebate are completed trips driven by the renter under the linked driver services agreement with drop-off in the rental week.

## Terms common to every vehicle class

| Term | Every Wayfare Rentals class |
|---|---|
| Rental week | Runs from the pickup weekday to the same weekday a week later; charges are booked on the first day of each week |
| Continuation | The rental continues week to week until the vehicle is returned |
| Part of a weekly charge refunded when the vehicle is returned mid-week | No |
| Shortest rental | 1 week |
| Fee for returning before the end of a rental week | $0.00 |
| First weekly charge and deposit | Booked at pickup |

## Reading the card: hypothetical weeks

These weeks are invented to show how the columns are read; the trip counts are not company figures.

- A Wayfare Rentals Minivan week with 52 completed trips reaches the 50-trip step and not the 70-trip step, so its rebate is $75.00.
- A Wayfare Rentals Premium Sedan week with 29 completed trips reaches no step, so it carries no rebate; with 30 trips the same week would carry $40.00.
- A Wayfare Rentals Electric Sedan week with 70 completed trips carries $105.00, the 70-trip amount alone.
- A Wayfare Rentals Economy Sedan picked up on a Thursday has rental weeks running Thursday to the following Thursday, and each weekly charge of $239.00 is booked on the Thursday that opens the week.
